SCENE sc_001 0-15500 INT. STONE CORRIDOR - NIGHT
EP35:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.
EP35:E2 0-5200 ACTION: Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.
EP35:E3 5500-8500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Determined, Breathless]: "I will not die in that house."
EP35:E4 9000-12800 CAMERA: Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.
EP35:E5 9500-12800 ACTION: She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.
EP35:E6 11200-13000 SOUND: Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.
EP35:E7 13000-15500 ACTION: The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.

EP35:E8 15500-19500 CAMERA: Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.
EP35:E9 15500-19500 ACTION: Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.
EP35:E10 16000-19500 SOUND: Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.

EP35:E12 21000-23000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Whispering, Weary]: "This must be the place."
EP35:E13 24000-27500 CAMERA: Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.
EP35:E14 24800-27000 SOUND: Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.
SCENE sc_003 27500-157500 INT. SECLUDED CABIN - CONTINUOUS
EP35:E15 27500-30800 CAMERA: Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.
EP35:E16 28500-30800 ACTION: Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
EP35:E17 30800-33800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.
EP35:E18 33800-36500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
EP35:E19 36500-40500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.
EP35:E20 37000-40000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Sobbing, Stunned]: "Alexander!"
EP35:E21 40500-44200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.
EP35:E22 42500-44200 ALEXANDER [Breathless, In Disbelief]: "Mother?"
EP35:E23 44200-47500 ACTION: She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.
EP35:E24 45500-48000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Weeping, Overwhelmed]: "You're alive."
EP35:E25 48000-49800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Choked Up]: "Mother."
EP35:E26 50000-55500 ACTION: She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.
EP35:E27 52500-55000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Tearful, Heartbroken]: "I buried you."
EP35:E28 56500-58000 ALEXANDER [Soft, Somber]: "I know."
EP35:E29 59500-66000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Anguished, Accusing]: "They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."
EP35:E30 66500-71000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.
EP35:E31 68500-70800 ALEXANDER [Dark, Resigned]: "Most of them were."
EP35:E32 71500-74000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Searching, Desperate]: "Then how did you survive?"
EP35:E33 74200-78000 CAMERA: Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.
EP35:E34 75000-77500 ALEXANDER [Grim, Quiet]: "I wasn't supposed to."
EP35:E35 78000-82500 ACTION: Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.
EP35:E36 79000-83000 ALEXANDER [Solemn]: "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
EP35:E37 83000-87000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.
EP35:E38 83000-89000 ALEXANDER [Steady, Focused]: "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
EP35:E39 87000-89800 ACTION: Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
EP35:E40 89800-92000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.
EP35:E41 89800-91500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Shocked]: "A traitor?"
EP35:E42 92000-93200 ALEXANDER [Cold, Firm]: "Yes."
EP35:E43 93500-97500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.
EP35:E44 94500-97000 ALEXANDER [Grave]: "We were close to finding him."
EP35:E45 98500-101000 ALEXANDER [Hardened]: "Then came the ambush."
EP35:E46 101200-104200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.
EP35:E47 101500-104200 ALEXANDER [Bitter, Painful]: "My men were slaughtered."
EP35:E48 104200-106500 CAMERA: Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.
EP35:E49 104500-106000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Trembling, Anxious]: "And you?"
EP35:E50 107000-110000 ALEXANDER [Hollow]: "I was shot. Left for dead."
EP35:E51 110000-113500 CAMERA: Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.
EP35:E52 111000-113000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Pleading, Astonished]: "How did you escape?"
EP35:E53 113500-118000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.
EP35:E54 114000-118000 ALEXANDER [Somber, Low]: "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
EP35:E55 118200-122000 ALEXANDER [Continuing]: "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
EP35:E56 122000-125500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.
EP35:E57 122000-125500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Aghast, Stunned]: "Then why did they never tell us?"
EP35:E58 125500-129500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.
EP35:E59 126000-129500 ALEXANDER [Ominous, Deliberate]: "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
EP35:E60 129500-130500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Breathless]: "Who?"
EP35:E61 130500-134000 ACTION: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
EP35:E62 131000-134000 ALEXANDER [Brooding]: "I spent three years trying to find out."
EP35:E63 134000-136800 ACTION: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
EP35:E64 134000-137000 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Resolute]: "The ambush was not an accident."
EP35:E65 137000-144000 ACTION: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
EP35:E66 137000-140500 ALEXANDER [Vehement, Enraged]: "Someone ordered my men to die."
EP35:E67 141000-144000 ALEXANDER [Darkly Intimating]: "Someone wanted me erased."
EP35:E68 144000-145000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Gasping, Terrified]: "Who?"
EP35:E69 145000-150500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.
EP35:E70 145500-150000 ALEXANDER [Deadly, Chilling]: "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."
EP35:E71 150500-157500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.
